text:
Eva Chen: Quick heads-up — profiler shows a p95 spike on route `chat-lite` right after the kernel switchover at 03:12 UTC. Looks correlated with higher KV cache miss rate + smaller effective microbatches. Posting short logs below.

Matt L: Saw the alert. Do we have the token_budget snapshot by tier? My hunch: kernel cost estimate changed and token budget kept the same, so per-request batching shrank.

Sara P: Traces attached. For seq_len ~256 the new kernel has poorer prefetch behavior; median is fine but tail doubled. p95 for `standard` tier went 210ms -> 340ms.

perf-bot: PERF ALERT: route=chat-lite p95>SLO(250ms) for 12m. Count=312 requests.

Eva Chen: Proposal: adjust dynamic token_budget targets for chat-lite to account for new kernel cost profile and add a KV-prefetch flag enabled for the canary. Lower standard tier token_budget so microbatches form faster but with lower tail exposure. Example config (yaml):

```
route_configs:
  chat-lite:
    tiers:
      standard:
        token_budget: 900
        max_microbatch: 8
        kernel_hint: 'fast-attn-prefetch'
      enterprise:
        token_budget: 1400
        max_microbatch: 16
```

Jonah K: Regarding rollout, can we canary this to 1% of serving nodes and keep automatic fallback to the old kernel when kv_miss_rate > 5% or p95 exceeds 1.5x baseline? Need to avoid user-facing regressions.

Matt L: Agree. Also recommend adding `seq_len_histogram` to the selector input. Current kernel selector uses a single avg cost number; we should pick kernel by cost_by_bucket (e.g., <64,64-256,256-1024).

Ash V: I'll schedule a canary tonight at 00:30 PT (1% nodes). I'll wire dashboards: p95, kv_miss_rate, microbatch_size_dist, and kernel_switch_rate. ETA ~2h for rollout + verification.

Sara P: If canary shows improvement on standard tier without hurting enterprise, we should push a staged rollout and tune token_budget upward for enterprise to keep throughput. Also add a quick A/B eval on prompt set to verify no quality regression.

Eva Chen: I'll author the experiment card with evaluation plan and the rollback playbook (trigger conditions: p95>300ms for 5m OR kv_miss_rate>0.07 for 3m). Will also add a perf regression alert to the CI. :thumbsup:

perf-bot: Canary job queued: id=canary-171999. Monitoring hooks added.

Jonah K: One more note — update the batching heuristics doc to call out that token_budget targets can be dynamically scaled by kernel_cost_estimate * safety_margin. That will make future kernel swaps safer.

Ash V: Copy. I'll capture notes in the runbook and drop a short summary in #eng-runtime after verification.

Eva Chen: Thanks all — will follow up with the experiment card link once created.
